_comment: Cosmetic battle-animation speedups for the owner's own TTR client. factor = speed multiplier (2.0 = twice as fast / roughly half the duration). Set enabled:false to leave a group untouched. Combat run-in scales client walk speed, which brings the client-driven d_joinDone forward (see README).

hud._comment: Always-on street-view overlay: current tasks, gag inventory, and street name. Shown only while on a street (hidden in playgrounds/interiors) unless always_show is set.
